summary: Autoregressive decoding relies on the KV cache, whose memory footprint grows linearly with context length and caps batch size and throughput. Existing post-training methods exploit redundancy across tokens, layers, and feature dimensions, or lower numerical precision.
takeaways: Existing post-training methods exploit redundancy across tokens, layers, and feature dimensions, or lower numerical precision.
The predictor can be initialised by meta-learning for substantially reduced prefill overhead, or fitted from scratch in settings that allow a one-off cost, such as multi-query inference.
We identify a complementary axis: within each attention head, values are largely predictable from their corresponding keys.
